labels.note: Attribute values containing '=' split at last '=' instead of first, corrupting attr name and value.
Scan breaks at ';', so attrEqIdx is always -1 or < endIdx; reset never triggers.
attrEqIdx never equals endIdx; condition unreachable either way.
Only attribute values of exactly 1024 chars get dropped; boundary edge case.
Bare 'Domain' attribute without '=' makes val undefined, and charCodeAt throws TypeError.
Path still handled by default; but empty attr (trailing ';') now overwrites path with undefined.
Empty/undefined val gives Invalid Date, rejected by isFinite check anyway.
Cap date moves to the past; every future Expires is clamped to 400 days ago.
